text.p: Digi International Inc said Thursday that Jerry A. Dusa, who has been acting interim chief executive officer since January, was named president and chief executive officder, effective immediately.
He also was named to Digi's board of directors.
Digi said Dusa has over 20 years of experience with several high-technology companies.

"Jerry Dusa's extensive industry background, his proven ability to lead high-technology enterprises, and his management skills have become apparent as Digi has begun to re-energize the strength of the company," John Schinas, chairman, said in a statement. "We are confident that Jerry will lead Digi's return to a level of consistent profitability that is acceptable to our shareholders."
Digi provides data communications hardware and software.
